result.changelog:
Applied every error, noncanon and missing item from the fact-check report, and checked the unverified items with 9 fetches plus 1 search (Metroid Wiki Fusion/Restricted Laboratory/Restricted Zone/SA-X/Sub-Zero Containment/B.S.L/Omega Metroid/Dachora, Wikipedia Fusion, Metroid Database ending).
- Incident entry: Samus's orders are now to exterminate the X, not keep them out. Story order fixed: the breeding program and "no fewer than ten SA-X" come before Neo-Ridley; the capture plan and the withheld Plasma Beam come after. The Omega fight uses the same SA-X. The ship crashes after the escape pod ejects her. The vaccine is now sourced to the baby Metroid. "No regret" removed.
- Station entry: Zebes creatures are no longer called SR388 samples. Samus releases the security locks at Security Rooms. The self-destruct is tied to the Main Boiler. The Nightmare line is now quoted from the computer.
- Sectors entry: added the Bomb data in TRO, the SA-X Power Bomb sighting in NOC and the five atmospheric stabilizers.
- Main Deck entry: Arachnus is the first Core-X, not the first X-mimic. Restricted Zone access and the stalled-elevator Core-X corrected.
- Restricted Lab entry: dropped the wiki's guess about why the Metroids spared Samus. Added the computer's claim that an Omega could be grown from a larva in days and that every hatch had the top lock grade. "That research is finished" and the breeding-program line were confirmed verbatim, so both stay as quotes.
- Omega entry: added the rapid-growth hint and the four Omegas Samus killed on SR388; removed the editorializing.
- Destruction entry: the "second world erased" line now names Zebes, Dark Aether and Phaaze. The final-order quote, "Any objections, Lady?", was confirmed and kept. Removed the unverified "station alone was not enough" reasoning and the claim that the animals were the same ones from Zebes. Added the tribunals line and Adam's reply.
- Defiance entry: story order split into two admissions; "without thinking" removed; Plasma Beam added; the station is now called a Federation contractor's.
- Keys: removed generic keys (survey team, escape pod, research station, Biologic, collision course, orbit path, any objections, secret lab, bare Omega, generic room names). Sectors, Omega and Defiance entries now require BSL/X context words as secondary keys (AND_ANY). Dropped keys already owned by other domains (X outbreak, Metroid breeding).
- Style: removed gameplay words, including "level". Word counts are 549/378/402/395/308/270/378/357.
result.unresolved:
- Sector 3 boiler saboteur: Metroid Wiki pages disagree (an X vs the SA-X), so the entries say "the X".
- The ending quotes come from a fan transcript (metroiddatabase.com); no official script was available.
- "Only survivors were Etecoons and a Dachora" is inferred from the Etecoon page, not stated outright.
- Where the Omega Metroid came from is only hinted at in the sources.
- The SRX location of the Neo-Ridley fight and the lab's Alpha/Gamma/Zeta stock come from the draft's sources and were not re-fetched.
- The Sectors entry is 402 words, slightly over the 400 default.
- "Restricted Zone" is still a key on the Restricted Lab entry despite the report flagging it as generic.
